negative_reviews.text:
My ramen was very disappointing. I got the most expensive ramen and it had 5 pieces of meat, noodles, one egg, and a bit of one vegetable. I hope it was a one time messed up dish since we ate at 7:30pm and the restaurant closes at 8:00pm. The story of the founder sounded great!
Gluten-free is not an option.

negative_reviews.author: Fiona Yu
negative_reviews.text:
⭐☆☆☆☆ (1/5)

Very disappointing experience. We came back because our first visit was good, but the quality has dropped dramatically.

The so-called soft-boiled ramen egg was completely hard-boiled with no runny yolk at all. The pork katsu was badly overcooked and black on the outside, making it dry, unpleasant and impossible to eat. Even more disappointing, the "Japanese " tonkotsu served with the ramen was just small pieces of shredded pork, not proper slices of tonkotsu as you would expect from a Japanese restaurant.

This was nowhere near the standard a restaurant serving Japanese food should offer. The food quality was extremely poor and nothing like our previous visit 9 months ago.

The only positive was that the staff were friendly and helpful. The ramen were remade and they apologized for the batch of fully boiled eggs (yet they still served them to customers) with a slightly discounted price. Unfortunately good service could not make up for the very disappointing food. The chef should genuinely understands and delivers the authenticity of the food they are selling.

Sadly, we won't be returning unless the food quality improves significantly.

negative_reviews.author: N A
negative_reviews.text:
Visited and decided we were going to sit outside. All the staff were inside huddled together in a corner chatting and didn't even notice I was standing by the door waiting for someone to hand me a menu and ask whether they accepted cash. It actually took one of the chefs to notice me and tell them there was a customer waiting. I honestly didn't even realise they were the staff because the atmosphere made it seem like they were just a group of friends sitting around laughing and talking together. Very unprofessional.

I was told cash was accepted, but when the same staff member came to take our order, she said that because we were sitting outside we'd have to scan the QR code on the table and pay by card. I reminded her that I'd already said we'd be paying cash, which really should have been explained from the beginning.

She then said she could take our order, but we'd have to pay straight after ordering, which was absolutely fine. However, when she told me the total, it was higher than what I'd worked out from the menu prices. She hadn't mentioned that a service charge had been added, and I had to ask twice before she explained what the extra charge was.

Considering the service we'd already received, I asked for the service charge to be removed. From that point on, her attitude noticeably changed and the customer service became even worse. When we finished eating, I thanked her and got no response at all.

The food itself tasted good, but for the price, the portion sizes were very small and definitely need improving.

Overall, a very disappointing experience. The lack of professionalism, poor communication and unfriendly service completely overshadowed the food. Unfortunately, I won't be returning.
